card.name: Commas and linking words in symptom lists
card.fires_on: Punctuation or short linking words that sit just before the next item in a list of symptoms, mainly the comma after 'rapid weight gain' in heart-failure warnings. It also fires on 'include' or 'and' inside adrenal insufficiency symptom lists.

modes.label: Comma after weight gain
modes.description: The comma following 'excessive, rapid weight gain' in the heart failure sign list, before 'dyspnea'.
modes.example: monitor patients carefully for signs and symptoms of heart failure (e.g., excessive, rapid weight gain<<,>> dyspnea, and/or edema

modes.label: Link word in adrenal symptom list
modes.description: The word 'include' or 'and' leading into or inside a list of adrenal insufficiency symptoms.
modes.example: Presentation of adrenal insufficiency may<< include>> non-specific symptoms and signs including nausea,

modes.label: Stray number or phrase
modes.description: Occasional unrelated spots, such as a digit inside a pressure value or a word after a quoted name.
